content.rendered:
The Scholastic Book Fair is from October 21st to October 25th. The book fair is a temporary event that brings books from many publishers, including new best sellers, classics and exclusive titles to encourage reading and raise money for our school library. We will also have posters and fun items for purchase. Each class will visit the Book Fair during their library time on Monday, Tuesday or Wednseday. Families are welcome to stop by and shop on Thursday between 8:00 am and 7:30 pm and Friday from 8:00-10:00 am during our conference days.

We need volunteers for our Scholastic Book Fair! Please click HERE to see all the opportunites to help.
